# Sorting: Soar agent from the Rosie teaching script

**Runnable.** `sorting-puzzle.soar` loads the shared library (`Soar/soar-library`, v2.34) and `sorting-puzzle-rules.soar` (11 task rules, generated by `gen.py` from the statements in `english-input.txt`). Needs Soar 9.6.6.

## Run

    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . sorting-puzzle.soar --seed 1 --cap 200000
    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . sorting-puzzle.soar --json | python3 ../../tools/check_plan.py sorting-puzzle init-sorting.world

`gen.py` regenerates the rules (`tools/rosie_tasks.py`, function `sorting`); `python3 gen.py WORLD` writes the same rules with
another example state as the initial world, for the state checks.

## Results (Soar 9.6.6, library v2.34, 16 Nov 2026)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Example states | init-sorting: goal false; final-sorting: goal true |
| Seeds 1-3, library defaults | solved, 3 moves each (the shortest: three blocks are misplaced), 3,649 / 3,397 / 3,341 decisions |
| Independent replay | every move legal, goal holds |
| Settings probe (P6, `probe.json`) | operator depth: 9 moves over 3 seeds, 10,384 decisions; tie-impasse solved 1 of 3 seeds within 200,000 decisions. Library defaults kept |

## Assumption ledger (places where the English is open)

| ID | Reading |
|---|---|
| A-S1 | "You can move a block onto a location": any block, onto any location other than the one it is on. In the world files every block lies directly on a location, so no block is ever under another. |
| A-S2 | "all the red blocks are on a red location and ...": each block is on a location of its own color, expanded over the six blocks of the world file, so the goal test is positive. |
| A-S3 | The action has no name in the dialog; it is called `move`. |

Convention notes: no concept needs maintaining; on and below are maintained by the move.
